commands.name: repos
commands.description: Open Repo Radar, your GitHub dashboard (/repos widget opens the desktop widget)
commands.output: Repo Radar opened docked on the right. Esc closes it.

commands.name: release-check
commands.description: Check your latest releases have every asset the release before had (optionally name one repo)
commands.output: Repo Radar has not finished its first scan yet. Try again in a moment.

commands.name: repos-import
commands.description: Import older clone history into Repo Radar: a JSON file path, or owner/repo:path on GitHub
commands.output:
Usage: /repos-import <file>  or  /repos-import <owner/repo>:<path>
The file is JSON: { "by_repo": { "owner/name": { "days": { "YYYY-MM-DD": clones } } } }

children: Sign in with the GitHub CLI, then press Refresh:
No gh? Paste a token into Repo Radar's github_token setting in /config.
